name: Discord VC
author: Marobotic
description: Live Discord voice-call status in the bar: a ping-coloured dot, the name of whoever is talking (your own when the channel is quiet), and a mic indicator driven by Discord's own voice detection rather than the local PipeWire source. Clicking it opens the server, channel and everyone in the call, plus the voice server and exact ping.

barWidget.description: Voice call ping, speaker and mic state
